releases.notes:
Release 2.0 for Fabric

Includes all features from release 2.0:
- Added Strong and Long variants for all potions (as well for their splash and lingering potions and tipped arrows) -> the Luck Potion has more potion variants: *check the description*
- Added the vanilla mechanic that prevents potions to receive enhancement and extension at the same time (except for Luck Potion: *check the description*)
- Changed and tweaked potion durations: *check the description*
- Changed the `en-us.json` language file to implement these new changes
